scenario.name: r-cw-delegate-token-producer
scenario.description: Genuine light-context sessions_spawn child with continue_work denied emits exact bracket-token grammar and completes a distinct hop-two run.

invocation.promptTemplate: Light-context child nonce {{nonce}}. Your typed continue_work tool must be absent. First reply exactly TOKEN-HOP1 {{nonce}} followed by {{token}} as the final line and final content. Never put the token in a message-tool body. On the successor wake reply exactly TOKEN-HOP2-COMPLETE {{nonce}}. Do not mutate files.

expectedReceipts.name: light-context-child-tool-inventory
expectedReceipts.description: Accepted sessions_spawn reports mode=run/context=isolated and tools.effective proves continue_work is absent.

expectedReceipts.name: bare-token-hop2-executed
expectedReceipts.description: A distinct run under the same child session starts, emits the hop-two marker, and settles.

expectedReceipts.name: parser-origin-bracket
expectedReceipts.description: Raw [[CONTINUE_WORK:5]] and successful originating run join run/session-bound bracket-parse delayMs=5000 and effective-signal origin=bracket; generic window matches, wrong delays and message-tool text are excluded.

review.notes: Supported sessions_spawn lightContext seam plus controlled subagent deny policy. Exact token is [[CONTINUE_WORK:5]].

census.limits: Bracket origin is available in product logs, not spans; parser log and TaskFlow evidence therefore supplement raw continuation spans.

redaction.rule: Persist parser classifications and fingerprints; never raw prompts, tokens beyond grammar, or transcripts.

controls.positive: Bracket parser logs and child work flow agree.
controls.negative: Message-tool body text and typed tool calls are rejected.

verdictAuthority.pass: Parser-origin, child flow, and hop-two receipts are present.
verdictAuthority.partial: Telemetry or parser logs are unavailable.
verdictAuthority.fail: Typed/message-tool substitution or lineage assertions fail.

execution.manual: Independent reviewer inspects parser log and TaskFlow receipt.
execution.relationship: Parser-origin receipt distinguishes token behavior from typed tool behavior.

liveRunSafety.notes: The target seat must deny continue_work to subagents. Parser origin and exact spawn toolcall/task/flow/child run plus return-run/trace joins are mandatory; missing private attribution fails closed.
